data.title: 芙莉莲 · 超市试吃
data.description: 【芙莉莲 · 超市试吃】大型超市热闹的熟食试吃区前，芙莉莲神情极其严肃地用牙签扎起一小块煎香肠放入口中，细细咀嚼后认真地点了点头——「味道很浓郁。听说只要假装挑选商品就能免费一直吃……这种被称作‘试吃’的习俗，简直比寻找魔法书还要美妙。」
data.promptProse: Frieren lifts a single cooked-sausage sample on a toothpick at the supermarket tasting counter during a modern fantasy outing. Her other hand rests near the tray as she considers the flavor gravely, then nods in approval. The medium view keeps her soft casual dress against receding aisle shelves. Even ceiling light catches green eyes and silver-white twintails, brightening the bite and leaving small tray shadows on the counter.
